Nintendo’s Switch 2: A Surprising Edge Over PS5 and Xbox? Smaller Game sizes Could Give Nintendo a Key Advantage.
April 9, 2025
The Next-gen Console Battle Takes an Unexpected Turn
While Sony’s PlayStation 5 and Microsoft’s Xbox Series X boast remarkable technical specifications, Nintendo’s upcoming Switch 2 might just have a trick up its sleeve. The advantage? Substantially smaller game download sizes.
Switch 2: Performance and Portability The Switch 2 is expected to offer a performance boost compared to its predecessor, allowing for graphically intensive games.Though, it’s unlikely to match the raw power of the PS5 or Xbox Series X. The switch 2 will, of course, be playable portable.
The Real Advantage: Game Size The key differentiator lies in the size of the games themselves. Current graphic-intensive games for the PS5 and Xbox are real chunks that with good and happy 100 GB memory size and open more. To install Indiana Jones and the Great Circle on the PS5, for exmaple, requires Your full 125 GB free space .
